prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t objectively name one single “best” lawyer for every car wreck — the right attorney depends on your case (how serious the injuries are, who’s at fault, insurance issues) and what you want (trial experience vs. quick settlement, communication style, etc.). I can, however, tell you how to find the best lawyer for your situation and give practical next steps.

What to look for
- Relevant experience: handles car wreck/personal injury cases regularly and has experience with cases like yours (catastrophic injury, soft-tissue, wrongful death, uninsured motorists, etc.).
- Trial experience: many good offers come from firms that will actually try cases if needed.
- Track record: documented settlements/verdicts in similar cases (not just marketing claims).
- Resources: can hire medical and accident reconstruction experts when needed.
- Communication: clear point of contact and responsiveness.
- Fee structure: contingency fee (typical 33–40% in Texas) and clear explanation of costs and expenses.
- Reputation and discipline: no serious disciplinary history with the State Bar of Texas.

Important practical facts
- Statute of limitations in Texas for personal injury (including most car wrecks): generally 2 years from the date of the crash. Don’t delay contacting an attorney.
- Most personal injury lawyers offer a free initial consultation and work on contingency (you pay only if they recover money).

Places to find and check attorneys
- Texas State Bar website (verify license and disciplinary history)
- Martindale-Hubbell (ratings)
- Super Lawyers lists
- Million Dollar Advocates (for very large verdicts/settlements)
- AVVO and Google reviews (read multiple reviews, not just one)
- Local recommendations (friends, medical providers)

Questions to ask in a first consult
- How many car accident cases have you handled? How many like mine?
- Who will handle my case (attorney or junior staff)?
- What is your trial experience and trial win/loss record?
- What do you think my case is worth and why?
- What is your fee and who pays costs up front?
- How will you communicate with me and how often?
- Can you provide references from past clients?

If you want, I can:
- Suggest a short list of well-reviewed Houston personal injury attorneys (if you want me to, tell me whether you prefer large firms or small local firms and any special circumstances: severe injuries, uninsured driver, hit-and-run, multiple-vehicle wreck, etc.).
- Provide a short script to use in initial consultations.
Tell me more about your crash (injuries, date, any charges or insurance issues) and how you’d like the lawyer to handle the case, and I’ll help narrow options.
